title: Warehouse Supervisor | GMG | KSA | Riyadh | Saudi National
description: Official GMG logistics role in Riyadh covering warehouse paperwork and flow coordination, shipment follow-up, stock damage and write-off handling, binning and tagging, health and safety checks, periodic equipment maintenance follow-up, team supervision, staff appraisals, stock allocation, shipment status reporting, and day-to-day distribution-centre organization. The role asks for 1-3 years of experience in the same supervisory capacity and retail warehousing experience.
